name: peekaround
description: PeekAround — modern, animated media gallery for your folders. Docker, desktop and Android.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @peekaround/server" "npm run dev -w @peekaround/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @peekaround/web && npm run build -w @peekaround/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @peekaround/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @peekaround/server && npm run test -w @peekaround/web
